title: Fermenter CIP
text: Caustic at 1.5 percent and 70 C for 30 minutes, then rinse and acid at 1.0 percent.

title: Fermenter CIP
text: Verify the return temperature reaches 68 C. If not, rerun the caustic step and log it.

title: Yeast pitching
text: Pitch at 10 million cells per mL at 12 P. Check viability above 90 percent before pitching.

title: Filler start up
text: Check fill heights on every head in the first ten minutes. Lower limit 495 ml for a 500 ml pack.

title: Confined space
text: A fermenter is a confined space. Entry only under a permit to work with a standby person.

title: Batch release
text: Release is a decision by the quality lead on lab results. No tool or assistant releases a batch.
